facts.value: The main goal of any construction project is to make a building that can be used for different purposes such as infrastructure, residential or commercial use.
Manufacturing projects consist of manufacturing physical products to generate profits for a company.
Information technology projects consist in establishing an IT framework for the processing of data at a company-wide scale.
The main goal of a software development project is to create a software product for a client.
The term business project could refer to creating a new business, creating a new business unit for an existing company or simply launching a new business initiative.
